results.evidence: Complete registered Lake build passes. Fresh kernel checks pass for CellTailProgram, CellTailChecks and CellTailWitnessSources; all 3476 exact dependency reports contain only standard Lean axioms. Proof source guard covers 364 Lean files. All 29 hardware Python tests pass. Binding checks pass for 30 saved layouts, 720 contraction blocks, 630 shared-store blocks and 30 residual entries; contraction audit covers 92 endpoints. All 98 contraction and 96 instruction receipt source hashes match. Proposed tree unchanged before/after checks. Stratic and local documentation links validate. Unchanged legacy interpreter checks were not freshly rerun. Semantic review confirms actual-machine state has no ghost execution, barrier release requires common live PC, tail frames preserve register 11, padding targets actual ret, and omitted events are global stores. General actual-store bounds and final stored-tensor recovery are explicitly unimplemented.
